note: Raw File Separator U+001C is a control byte below 0x20 that is NOT a section 3.3 whitespace member (unlike TAB/VT/FF), so it is excluded from <key-char> per section 4 and must not be trimmed. Python's str.isspace() incorrectly returns True for U+001C-U+001F (noted in section 3.3); an implementation that trims via isspace() before validating key-char would silently strip this byte and wrongly accept the key as valid.
